purpose: Source-publication readiness; not production or release qualification
result: No unresolved credential or customer-data disclosure finding in the reviewed content

scanner.name: gitleaks
scanner.rules: built-in defaults; repository and inline suppressions bypassed; redacted output
scanner.exit_codes: Scans with candidates exited 1; contextual triage resolved every candidate as non-secret.

github_discussions.review: Full-content pattern scans and contextual inspection of flagged content and non-GitHub links

github_actions_history.unavailable_log_result: HTTP 404; inventory conclusion failure; no inference about absent content or reason
github_actions_history.disposition: All sourcegraph-access-token matches were SARIF commitSha fields, verified with git cat-file -t as existing CogniStore commits.

source_review.workflows: All four use standard ubuntu-24.04 runners, explicit read-only permissions and pinned actions; no privileged fork trigger, self-hosted runner, real-cloud deployment, repository-secret reference or publishing step found.
source_review.assets: Synthetic fixture/sample data and existing notices reviewed; python-docx default-template attribution clarified by accompanying documentation change.

privacy_metadata: Existing Git history/evidence includes maintainer name/email, local home paths and machine hostname. These remain visible as ordinary development metadata.

repository_settings_verified.main_branch_protection: not protected (HTTP 404); no protection changes made
repository_settings_verified.releases: One draft release retained as draft; no release published

validation.documentation: git diff --check; 89 local link targets checked; copied python-docx MIT notice identical; workflow executable content unchanged
validation.hosted_ci: No fresh run executed as part of the exposure audit; publication authorizes subsequent hosted CI. Historical skipped runs remain skipped.

limitations: Pattern scanning and focused manual review do not prove absence of all sensitive data.
Unreachable or superseded server-only Git objects not exposed through fetched refs were not enumerable.
86 historical log archives were unavailable for review.
Draft-release binary assets were not published or audited by this exposure review.
This review does not qualify the production candidate or clear its recorded security advisories.
